signs.Aries: You partner may feel encouraged to do more talking than they have for some time, so for once put down that soda and bag of potato chips, pull up your chair and listen. What they have to say affects the two of you in very major ways, so you need to take it all in and focus. Then take time to give the most appropriate responses.
signs.Taurus: Today words are slow, rich, potent, and very intense. One word could be taken in different ways, and much of what you say to your loved one has the potential to transform your relationship. The energy of the day is that powerful. If you want to make changes for the better, then focus on all the good things that you can do together in the future.
signs.Gemini: This is a great time to share some of your deepest and most vulnerable feelings with your close partner. If you can truly open up instead of telling half-truths or even lies to cover what you think are major faults, then you will also do yourself a really big favor. It will bring you real peace of mind and a feeling of serenity.
signs.Cancer: You may feel awkward today, especially as your sweetie pie seems to want to bring up that sensitive subject - the one you dislike talking about. But like it or not, you are going to have to hold that conversation and consider how you are both going to deal with this particular issue. Do it now, while you have the chance to make positive change.
signs.Leo: It's not that your current idea isn't brilliant, it's just that your partner needs a lot of time to think through all the various options before agreeing with you that it is brilliant. You need to discuss many aspects of it together before you put it into practice. But the positive difference it will make to your lives will be worth it.
signs.Virgo: Conversations can definitely change things today. Any discussions will be powerful in the extreme and will challenge many of the ideals and values that you hold dear. Although you may find this process a little uncomfortable, it will ultimately help your current relationship to blossom in many ways. If you can be real about how you feel, this will create even more potent changes.
signs.Libra: You can fix your lover, or your lover-to-be, with that extremely powerful, very seductive, there's absolutely-no-escape kind of look, and watch as they crumble helplessly under your awesome gaze. You have your pick of the bunch, so make sure you choose someone who is worthy of all that you are able to bestow upon them so passionately.
signs.Scorpio: You may have tried to keep this particular secret for a long time, silently hidden away in the discreet space between your ears. However, your time is up, and you may well be found out. Your partner's antennae are very finely tuned to subtle frequencies and can pick up a little lie immediately. It's not too bad a secret, after all, so best be honest.
signs.Sagittarius: You will feel a strong desire to look deeply at another's motives. Usually you are too preoccupied with your own issues to worry about another's agenda, but in this case, you may not be able to help quietly reflecting. You also need to discuss what you think their issues might be, especially if they appear to affect you more directly than you first imagined. Make sure you get your bearings!
signs.Capricorn: You may feel like running away, especially if you are put on the spot concerning your current relationship. This is likely to be a very intense day, and your partner will show no mercy in making you aware of any shortcomings about which they may be unhappy. If you can bear to stay put, then do so. You may learn something valuable, not only about yourself, but also about each other.
signs.Aquarius: You won't find this day difficult to deal with, as you may quite relish the passion and intensity of the conversations you hold with that special person in your life. You are not frightened of deep feelings, as you know how to allow them to flow, and therefore you are not scared off by this in another. All in all, you are in for a wonderfully romantic evening.
signs.Pisces: The intensity of your current relationship may allow you to take that major step of meeting each other's family skeletons and spending a happy few hours as they rattle out of the closet. It may be more fun than meeting each other's parents, anyway. But you will also get to talk about your relationship and will discover how special it really is!
